tamil: 5. மூலமாயாந்தராங்கார பாகிய விகற்ப கிரியா லேச ஏகதேச காரிய பௌதிக பாகியத்துவார கிரியா வியக்தி மாத்திர கன்மேந்திரிய தத்துவ உலகு.
1. பூதேந்திரிய சம்பந்த கன்மவிஷயாணுத்வ சாத்திய கன்மேந்திரிய ரூபசத்தி உலகு.
2. துவார கன்மாணுத்துவ வியாபார சாத்திய கன்மேந்திரிய சொரூபசத்தி உலகு.
3. கன்ம விகற்ப விசித்திர உத்தியோகத்துவ கன்மேந்திரிய சுபாவசத்தி உலகு.
4. பூதபரியந்த சாதி சாமானிய கன்மேந்திரிய வியாத்திசத்தி உலகு.
5. மாயைபரியந்த உபாதி சாமானிய கன்மேந்திரிய வியாபகசத்தி உலகு.
8. அந்தரேந்திரிய சூக்கும விஷய கன்மேந்திரிய வர்னசத்தி உலகு.
10. சாமானிய கன்மாணுத்துவ கன்மேந்திரிய அபரத்துவ சத்தி உலகு.
11. கன்ம பகுவணுத்துவ சாத்திய கன்மேந்திரிய பாவ சத்தி உலகு.
1. சூக்கும சினேக கன்மாணுத்துவ சம்பந்த விசித்திர ரூப வியத்தியாதி சாதக சாத்திய கன்மேந்திரிய உற்பவ சத்தி உலகு.
4. கன்மேந்திரிய உற்பவ அதிகார லய அதிகரணசத்தி உலகு.
translation: 5. The world of the tattva of the organs of action, the manifestation of action alone through the physical exterior: a partial effect of a trace of outer action, with distinctions, of the sense of "I" within root maya.
1. The world of the form power of the organs of action, effected through the atomicity of the objects of acts, in relation to the elements and the senses.
2. The world of the own-form power of the organs of action, effected through the activity of the atomicity of acts at the apertures.
3. The world of the nature power of the organs of action, as manifold exertion in acts with distinctions.
4. The world of the pervasion power of the organs of action, general by kind, reaching as far as the elements.
5. The world of the pervading power of the organs of action, general by adjunct, reaching as far as maya.
6. The world of the particular power of the organs of action, as subtle conjunction.
7. The world of the quality power of the organs of action, as the inertness of maya.
8. The world of the colour power of the organs of action, in the subtle objects of the inner sense.
9. The world of the higher-order power of the organs of action, as the particular atomicity of acts.
10. The world of the lower-order power of the organs of action, as the general atomicity of acts.
11. The world of the being power of the organs of action, effected through the atomicity of many acts.
12. The world of the instrumental-cause power of the organs of action, as ground alone.
13. The world of the particular instrumental-cause power of the organs of action, as particular ground alone.
In the same way:

1. The world of the power of the arising of the organs of action, effecting and effected through the manifestation of manifold form and the rest, in relation to subtle cohesion and the atomicity of acts.
2. The world of the power of the functioning of the organs of action.
3. The world of the power of the dissolution of the organs of action.
4. The world of the substratum power of the arising, functioning and dissolution of the organs of action.
5. The world of the instrument power.
6. The world of the season power.
7. The world of the act power.
8. The world of the aid power.
9. The world of the impelling power, and the like are also to be counted.
commentary: The fifth tattva world is the five organs of action: speech, hands, feet, the organ of generation and the organ of excretion. The head calls them action made manifest outwardly through the body, a partial effect of the sense of "I" (ahankara) within root maya, the material source of the tattvas. The thirteen aspects follow, then the three phases with their supports.

sections.title: The Tattva Worlds: The Organs of Action One by One

tamil: 1. ஆகாயப்பிருதிவி சாதி சையோக சுரோத்திரோபாதி சம்பந்த வசனகன்ம விஷயாணுத்துவ சாத்திய வாக்குரூபசத்தி உலகு.
2. வாயுப் பிருதிவி சாதி சையோக தொக்குஉபாதி சம்பந்த தான கன்ம விஷயாணுத்துவ சாத்திய பாணிரூபசத்தி உலகு.
3. தேயுப் பிருதிவி சாதி சையோக நேத்திரோபாதி சம்பந்த கமன கன்மவிஷயாணுத்துவ சாத்திய பாதரூபசத்தி உலகு.
4. அப்புப் பிருதிவி சாதி சையோக சிகுவோபாதி சம்பந்த விசர்க்ககன்ம விஷயாணுத்துவ சாத்திய குய்யரூப சத்தி உலகு.
5. பிருதிவிப் பிருதிவி சாதி சையோக கிராணோபாதி சம்பந்த விசர்க்ககன்ம விஷயாணுத்துவ சாத்திய குதரூபசத்தி உலகு.
11. வசனகன்ம விகற்ப விசித்திர உத்தியோகத்துவ வாக்குசுபாவசத்தி உலகு.
12. கமனகன்ம விகற்ப விசித்திர உத்தியோகத்துவ பாதசுபாவசத்தி உலகு.
13. தானகன்ம விகற்ப விசித்திர உத்தியோகத்துவ பாணிசுபாவசத்தி உலகு.
14. விசர்க்ககன்ம விகற்ப விசித்திர உத்தியோகத்துவ குய்யசுபாவசத்தி உலகு.
21. பிரகிருதி உபாதி பரியந்த வாக்கு வியாபகசத்தி உலகு.
12. உற்பவ அதிகார லய அதிகரண சத்தி உலகு.
translation: Besides these:
1. The world of the form power of speech, effected through the atomicity of the objects of the act of speaking, in relation to the ear as adjunct and in conjunction by kind with earth within space.
2. The world of the form power of the hands, effected through the atomicity of the objects of the act of giving, in relation to the skin as adjunct and in conjunction by kind with earth within air.
3. The world of the form power of the feet, effected through the atomicity of the objects of the act of going, in relation to the eye as adjunct and in conjunction by kind with earth within fire.

4. The world of the form power of the organ of generation, effected through the atomicity of the objects of the act of excreting, in relation to the tongue as adjunct and in conjunction by kind with earth within water.

5. The world of the form power of the organ of excretion, effected through the atomicity of the objects of the act of excreting, in relation to the nose as adjunct and in conjunction by kind with earth within earth.
6. The world of the own-form power of speech, effected through speech as the activity of the atoms of the act of speaking.
7. The world of the own-form power of the feet, effected through the feet as the activity of the atoms of the act of going.
8. The world of the own-form power of the hands, effected through the hands as the activity of the atoms of the act of giving.
9. The world of the own-form power of the organ of generation, effected through the organ of generation as the activity of the atoms of the act of excreting.
10. The world of the own-form power of the organ of excretion, effected through the organ of excretion as the activity of the atoms of the act of excreting.
11. The world of the nature power of speech, as manifold exertion in the act of speaking with distinctions.
12. The world of the nature power of the feet, as manifold exertion in the act of going with distinctions.
13. The world of the nature power of the hands, as manifold exertion in the act of giving with distinctions.
14. The world of the nature power of the organ of generation, as manifold exertion in the act of excreting with distinctions.
15. The world of the nature power of the organ of excretion.
16. The world of the pervasion power of speech, reaching as far as the kind of earth within space.
17. The world of the pervasion power of the feet, reaching as far as the kind of earth within air.
18. The world of the pervasion power of the hands, reaching as far as the kind of earth within fire.
19. The world of the pervasion power of the organ of generation, reaching as far as the kind of earth within water.
20. The world of the pervasion power of the organ of excretion, reaching as far as the kind of earth within earth.
21. The world of the pervading power of speech, reaching as far as prakriti as adjunct.
22. The world of the pervading power of the feet.
23. The world of the pervading power of the hands.
24. The world of the pervading power of the organ of generation.
25. The world of the pervading power of the organ of excretion.
Besides these:
1. The world of the particular power of speech and the rest.
2. The world of the quality power.
3. The world of the colour power.
4. The world of the higher-order power.
5. The world of the lower-order power.
6. The world of the being power.
7. The world of the instrumental-cause power.
8. The world of the particular instrumental-cause power.
9. The world of the power of arising.
10. The world of the power of functioning.
11. The world of the power of dissolution.
12. The world of the substratum power of arising, functioning and dissolution.
13. The world of the instrument power.
14. The world of the season power.
15. The world of the act power.
16. The world of the aid power.
17. The world of the impelling power, and the like are also to be counted.
commentary: Each organ is now set beside its act (speaking, giving, going, excreting), a sense of knowledge as its adjunct, and an element within earth ("earth within space" and so on). Items 4 and 5 both name the act of excreting, as printed. After "Besides these" the remaining aspects and phases of speech and the rest are given by the changed word alone.

sections.title: The Tattva Worlds: The Inner Instrument

tamil: 6. சவிகற்ப இச்சா ஞானக் கிரியாலேச ஏகதேச மூலமாயாந்தராங்க சாங்க சூக்கும சங்கற்ப விகற்ப சமவாய காரிய பௌதிகோபாங்கத் துவார இந்திரிய அக்கிரகண்ணி யாங்க சாங்கத்துவாத்துவ அந்தக்கரண தத்துவ உலகு.
1. பௌதிகாந்தர சாதாரண சங்கற்ப சமவாயத்துவ அந்தக்கரண ரூபசத்தி உலகு.
2. பௌதிகாந்தர சாதாரண சங்கற்ப சமவாய சாத்திய அந்தக்கரண சொரூபசத்தி உலகு.
3. பௌதிகாந்தர சாதாரண சங்கற்ப விகற்ப சமவாய சாத்திய அந்தக்கரண சுபாவசத்தி உலகு.
4. புருடதத்துவ பரியந்த சாதி சாமானிய அந்தக்கரண வியாத்திசத்தி உலகு.
5. வித்தியாதத்துவ பரியந்த உபாதி சாமானிய அந்தக்கரண வியாபகசத்தி உலகு.
7. சங்கற்ப விகற்ப சாத்திய வந்நியாச அந்தக்கரண குண சத்தி உலகு.
8. சங்கற்ப விசித்திர சாத்திய அந்தக்கரண வர்னசத்தி உலகு.
11. சர்வ சங்கற்ப விகற்ப சாத்தியத்துவ அந்தக்கரண பாவசத்தி உலகு.
translation: 6. The world of the inner instrument tattva, a partial trace of desire, knowledge and action with distinctions; subtle and complete with limbs, an inner limb of root maya; the effect of the inherence of notions and distinctions; through the physical sub-limbs, the foremost limb of the senses, as complete with limbs.
1. The world of the form power of the inner instrument, as the inherence of common notions within the physical.
2. The world of the own-form power of the inner instrument, effected through the inherence of common notions within the physical.
3. The world of the nature power of the inner instrument, effected through the inherence of common notions and distinctions within the physical.
4. The world of the pervasion power of the inner instrument, general by kind, reaching as far as the purusha tattva.
5. The world of the pervading power of the inner instrument, general by adjunct, reaching as far as the vidya tattva.
6. The world of the particular power of the inner instrument, foremost in the cognition of objects.
7. The world of the quality power of the inner instrument, as fixing, effected through notions and distinctions.
8. The world of the colour power of the inner instrument, effected through manifold notions.
9. The world of the higher-order power of the inner instrument, as the particularity of notions.
10. The world of the lower-order power of the inner instrument, as the generality of notions.
11. The world of the being power of the inner instrument, as effected through all notions and distinctions.
In the same way:
12. The world of the instrumental-cause power of the inner instrument.
13. The world of the particular instrumental-cause power of the inner instrument.
14. The world of the power of the arising of the inner instrument.
15. The world of the power of the functioning of the inner instrument.
16. The world of the power of the dissolution of the inner instrument.
17. The world of the substratum power of the arising of the inner instrument.
18. The world of the instrument power of the arising of the inner instrument.
19. The world of the season power of the arising of the inner instrument.
20. The world of the act power of the arising of the inner instrument.
21. The world of the aid power of the arising of the inner instrument.
22. The world of the impelling power of the arising of the inner instrument.
23. The world of the substratum power of the functioning of the inner instrument.
24. The world of the instrument power of the functioning of the inner instrument.
25. The world of the season power of the functioning of the inner instrument.
26. The world of the act power of the functioning of the inner instrument.
27. The world of the aid power of the functioning of the inner instrument.
28. The world of the impelling power of the functioning of the inner instrument.
29. The world of the substratum power of the dissolution of the inner instrument.
30. The world of the instrument power of the dissolution of the inner instrument.
31. The world of the season power of the dissolution of the inner instrument.
32. The world of the act power of the dissolution of the inner instrument.
33. The world of the aid power of the dissolution of the inner instrument.
34. The world of the impelling power of the dissolution of the inner instrument.
commentary: The sixth tattva world is the inner instrument (antahkarana), in which the soul forms notions and distinctions about what the senses bring. Its pervasion reaches as far as the purusha tattva and its pervading as far as the vidya tattva: purusha is the soul as experiencer, vidya the tattva of limited knowledge. Here the numbering runs straight through 1-34 across "In the same way".

sections.title: The Tattva Worlds: The Mind

tamil: 7. மூலமாயாந்தராங்கார சவிகற்ப இச்சாலேச ஏகதேச காரணகாரிய பௌதிகாந்தர இச்சாசங்கற்ப விகற்ப விசித்திராலம்பத்துவ சாதக சாத்தியத்துவ மனோரூபசத்தி உலகு.
1. பௌதிகாந்தர இச்சாசங்கற்ப விகற்ப விசித்திராலம்ப சாமானிய சாத்திய மனோ சொரூபசத்தி உலகு.
2. பௌதிகாந்தர இச்சா சங்கற்ப விகற்ப விசித்திராலம்ப விஷய நியாச கன்ம மனோ சுபாவசத்தி உலகு.
3. புருடத்துவார சாதி சாமானிய பரியந்த மனோ வியாத்தி சத்தி உலகு.
4. வித்தியாத்துவார உபாதி சாமானிய பரியந்த மனோ வியாபகசத்தி உலகு.
5. விஷய இச்சா சங்கற்ப விசேஷ நியாச மனோவிசேடசத்தி உலகு.
6. விஷய இச்சா சங்கற்ப விகற்ப நிபிடத்துவ மனோகுணசத்தி உலகு.
7. விஷய இச்சா சங்கற்ப விகற்ப விவித விசித்திரத்துவ மனோவர்னசத்தி உலகு.
8. விஷய இச்சாசங்கற்ப சர்வ சாத்தியத்துவ மனோபாவசத்தி உலகு.
9. விஷய விசேட இச்சா சங்கற்ப விகற்பத்துவ மனோ பரத்துவ சத்தி உலகு.
10. விஷய சாமானிய சங்கற்ப விகற்பத்துவ மனோ அபரத்துவசத்தி உலகு.
11. விஷய இச்சா சங்கற்ப அதிட்டானத்துவ மனோ நிமித்தசத்தி உலகு.
12. விஷய இச்சா சங்கற்ப அதிட்டான விசேடத்துவ மனோ நிமித்த விசேடசத்தி உலகு.
13. விஷய இச்சா சங்கற்ப விகற்ப உற்பவாதி சாதன சாத்திய மனோற்பவசத்தி உலகு.
translation: Besides these:

7. The world of the form power of the mind, effecting and effected, with the manifold notions and distinctions of desire within the physical as its basis: the cause and effect of a partial trace of desire, with distinctions, of the sense of "I" within root maya.
1. The world of the own-form power of the mind, effected as general, with the manifold notions and distinctions of desire within the physical as basis.
2. The world of the nature power of the mind, the act of fixing on objects, with the manifold notions and distinctions of desire within the physical as basis.
3. The world of the pervasion power of the mind, through purusha, reaching as far as the general by kind.
4. The world of the pervading power of the mind, through vidya, reaching as far as the general by adjunct.
5. The world of the particular power of the mind, as the particular fixing of the notions of desire for objects.
6. The world of the quality power of the mind, as the density of the notions and distinctions of desire for objects.
7. The world of the colour power of the mind, as the various manifoldness of the notions and distinctions of desire for objects.
8. The world of the being power of the mind, as effected through all the notions of desire for objects.
9. The world of the higher-order power of the mind, as the distinction of the notions of desire for particular objects.
10. The world of the lower-order power of the mind, as the distinction of notions about objects in general.
11. The world of the instrumental-cause power of the mind, as the ground of the notions of desire for objects.
12. The world of the particular instrumental-cause power of the mind, as the particularity of the ground of the notions of desire for objects.
13. The world of the power of the arising of the mind, effected by means of the arising and the rest of the notions and distinctions of desire for objects.
14. The world of the power of the functioning of the mind.
15. The world of the power of the dissolution of the mind.
16. The world of the substratum power of the arising of the mind.
17. The world of the instrument power of the arising of the mind.
18. The world of the season power of the arising of the mind.
19. The world of the act power of the arising of the mind.
20. The world of the aid power of the arising of the mind.
21. The world of the impelling power of the arising of the mind.
22. The world of the substratum power of the functioning of the mind.
23. The world of the instrument power of the functioning of the mind.
24. The world of the season power of the functioning of the mind.
25. The world of the act power of the functioning of the mind.
26. The world of the aid power of the functioning of the mind.
27. The world of the impelling power of the functioning of the mind.
28. The world of the substratum power of the dissolution of the mind.
29. The world of the instrument power of the dissolution of the mind.
30. The world of the season power of the dissolution of the mind.
31. The world of the act power of the dissolution of the mind.
32. The world of the aid power of the dissolution of the mind.
33. The world of the impelling power of the dissolution of the mind.
commentary: The inner instrument is now taken in its four parts. The mind (manas) has no head line of its own: its world of form power stands as head 7, and its run begins with own form, so it has 33 items. The mind is the instrument of desire; its notions and distinctions rest on the many objects it wants.

sections.title: The Tattva Worlds: The Sense of "I"

tamil: 8. மூலமாயாந்தர விகற்பக் கிரியாலேச ஏகதேச கரண காரிய பௌதிகாந்தர கிரியா சங்கற்ப விகற்ப சாத்திய அகங்கார தத்துவ உலகு.
1. பௌதிகாந்தர கிரியா சங்கற்ப விகற்ப சமவாய நிச்சய அகம்பாவத்துவ அகங்கார ரூபசத்தி உலகு.
2. பௌதிகாந்தர கிரியா சங்கற்ப விகற்ப விவித குணோ பாங்க சமவாய அகம்பாவ சாத்திய அகங்கார சொரூபசத்தி உலகு.
3. பௌதிகாந்தர கிரியா சங்கற்ப விகற்ப விவிதகுண விசித்திராலம்பத்துவ அகம்பாவ அகங்காரசுபாவசத்தி உலகு.
4. பௌதிகாந்தர கிரியா சங்கற்ப விகற்ப புருஷபாவ பரியந்த அகங்கார வியாத்திசத்தி உலகு.
5. பௌதிகாந்தர கிரியா சங்கற்ப விகற்ப ஞானபாவ மாத்திர அகங்கார வியாபகசத்தி உலகு.
6. பௌதிகாந்தர கிரியா சங்கற்ப விகற்ப அகம்பாவ நியாசத்துவ அகங்கார விசேடசத்தி உலகு.
7. பௌதிகாந்தர கிரியா சங்கற்ப விகற்ப அகம்பாவ நிபிடத்துவ அகங்கார குணசத்தி உலகு.
8. பௌதிகாந்தர கிரியா சங்கற்ப விகற்ப அகம்பாவ விசித்திரத்துவ அகங்கார வர்னசத்தி உலகு.
9. பௌதிகாந்தர கிரியா சங்கற்ப அகம்பாவ சாத்தியத்துவ அகங்கார பாவசத்தி உலகு.
10. பௌதிகாந்தர சங்கற்ப விகற்ப அகம்பாவ விசேடத்துவ அகங்கார பரத்துவசத்தி உலகு.
11. பௌதிகாந்தர கிரியா சங்கற்ப விகற்ப அகம்பாவ சாமானியத்துவ அகங்கார அபரத்துவசத்தி உலகு.
12. கிரியா சங்கற்ப விகற்ப அதிட்டானத்துவ அகங்கார நிமித்த சத்தி உலகு.
13. கிரியா சங்கற்ப விகற்ப அதிட்டான விசேடத்துவ அகங்கார நிமித்த விசேடசத்தி உலகு.
14. கிரியா சங்கற்ப விகற்ப அகம்பாவஉற்பவாதி சாதன சாத்திய அகங்கார உற்பவசத்தி உலகு.
translation: 8. The world of the tattva of the sense of "I", effected through the notions and distinctions of action within the physical: the instrument and effect of a partial trace of action with distinctions within root maya.
1. The world of the form power of the sense of "I", as I-ness, inherent and certain, in the notions and distinctions of action within the physical.
2. The world of the own-form power of the sense of "I", effected through I-ness in inherence with the various qualities as sub-limbs, in the notions and distinctions of action within the physical.
3. The world of the nature power of the sense of "I", as I-ness with the manifold of various qualities as its basis, in the notions and distinctions of action within the physical.
4. The world of the pervasion power of the sense of "I", reaching as far as the being of purusha, in the notions and distinctions of action within the physical.
5. The world of the pervading power of the sense of "I", as the being of knowledge alone, in the notions and distinctions of action within the physical.
6. The world of the particular power of the sense of "I", as the fixing of I-ness in the notions and distinctions of action within the physical.
7. The world of the quality power of the sense of "I", as the density of I-ness in the notions and distinctions of action within the physical.
8. The world of the colour power of the sense of "I", as the manifoldness of I-ness in the notions and distinctions of action within the physical.
9. The world of the being power of the sense of "I", as effected through I-ness in the notions of action within the physical.
10. The world of the higher-order power of the sense of "I", as the particularity of I-ness in the notions and distinctions within the physical.
11. The world of the lower-order power of the sense of "I", as the generality of I-ness in the notions and distinctions of action within the physical.
12. The world of the instrumental-cause power of the sense of "I", as the ground of the notions and distinctions of action.
13. The world of the particular instrumental-cause power of the sense of "I", as the particularity of the ground of the notions and distinctions of action.
14. The world of the power of the arising of the sense of "I", effected by means of the arising and the rest of I-ness in the notions and distinctions of action.
15. The world of the power of the functioning of the sense of "I".
16. The world of the power of the dissolution of the sense of "I".
17. The world of the substratum power of the arising of the sense of "I".
18. The world of the instrument power of the arising of the sense of "I".
19. The world of the season power of the arising of the sense of "I".
20. The world of the act power of the arising of the sense of "I".
21. The world of the aid power of the arising of the sense of "I".
22. The world of the impelling power of the arising of the sense of "I".
23. The world of the substratum power of the functioning of the sense of "I".
24. The world of the instrument power of the functioning of the sense of "I".
25. The world of the season power of the functioning of the sense of "I".
26. The world of the act power of the functioning of the sense of "I".
27. The world of the aid power of the functioning of the sense of "I".
28. The world of the impelling power of the functioning of the sense of "I".
29. The world of the substratum power of the dissolution of the sense of "I".
30. The world of the instrument power of the dissolution of the sense of "I".
31. The world of the season power of the dissolution of the sense of "I".
32. The world of the act power of the dissolution of the sense of "I".
33. The world of the aid power of the dissolution of the sense of "I".
34. The world of the impelling power of the dissolution of the sense of "I".
commentary: The sense of "I" (ahankara) is the instrument of action: it takes each act as its own and holds to it with certainty, which is why every item turns on I-ness. The head prints "instrument and effect" where heads 9 and 10 have "cause and effect"; it is translated as printed.

sections.title: The Tattva Worlds: The Intellect

tamil: 9. மூலமாயாந்தர விகற்ப ஞானலேச ஏகதேச காரண காரிய பௌதிகாந்தர ஞானவிகற்ப சங்கற்பமாத்திர புத்தி தத்துவ உலகு.
1. பௌதிகாந்தர விகற்ப ஞான சங்கற்ப சமவாய விசாராலம்பத்துவ புத்திரூபசத்தி உலகு.
2. பௌதிகாந்தர விகற்ப ஞான சங்கற்ப விசாராலம்ப சாத்திய புத்தி சொரூபசத்தி உலகு.
3. பௌதிகாந்தர விகற்ப ஞான சங்கற்ப விசாராலம்ப சமவாய சாத்தியத்துவ புத்தி சுபாவசத்தி உலகு.
6. ஞான சங்கற்ப விகற்ப நியாச விசேட புத்தி விசேடசத்தி உலகு.
7. ஞான சங்கற்ப விகற்ப விசார நிபிடத்துவ புத்தி குணசத்தி உலகு.
8. விகற்ப ஞான சங்கற்ப விசார விசித்திரத்துவ புத்தி வர்னசத்தி உலகு.
9. விகற்ப ஞான சங்கற்ப விசார சாத்தியத்துவ புத்தி பாவசத்தி உலகு.
10. விகற்ப ஞான விசேட சங்கற்பத்துவ புத்தி பரத்துவசத்தி உலகு.
11. விகற்ப ஞான சாமானிய சங்கற்பத்துவ புத்தி அபரத்துவசத்தி உலகு.
12. விகற்ப ஞான சங்கற்ப அதிட்டானத்துவ புத்தி நிமித்தசத்தி உலகு.
13. விகற்ப ஞான சங்கற்ப அதிட்டான விசேடத்துவ புத்தி நிமித்த விசேட சத்தி உலகு.
14. விகற்ப ஞான சங்கற்ப விசாரோற்பவாதி சாதன சாத்திய புத்தி உற்பவசத்தி உலகு.
translation: 9. The world of the intellect tattva, the distinctions and notions of knowledge alone within the physical: the cause and effect of a partial trace of knowledge with distinctions within root maya.
1. The world of the form power of the intellect, with inquiry as its basis, in the inherence of the notions of knowledge with distinctions within the physical.
2. The world of the own-form power of the intellect, effected with inquiry as basis, in the notions of knowledge with distinctions within the physical.
3. The world of the nature power of the intellect, as effected through inherence with inquiry as basis, in the notions of knowledge with distinctions within the physical.
4. The world of the pervasion power of the intellect, reaching as far as the inquiry of purusha.
5. The world of the pervading power of the intellect, reaching as far as the vidya tattva.
6. The world of the particular power of the intellect, as the particular fixing of the notions and distinctions of knowledge.
7. The world of the quality power of the intellect, as the density of inquiry in the notions and distinctions of knowledge.
8. The world of the colour power of the intellect, as the manifoldness of inquiry in the notions of knowledge with distinctions.
9. The world of the being power of the intellect, as effected through inquiry in the notions of knowledge with distinctions.
10. The world of the higher-order power of the intellect, as particular notions of knowledge with distinctions.
11. The world of the lower-order power of the intellect, as general notions of knowledge with distinctions.
12. The world of the instrumental-cause power of the intellect, as the ground of the notions of knowledge with distinctions.
13. The world of the particular instrumental-cause power of the intellect, as the particularity of the ground of the notions of knowledge with distinctions.
14. The world of the power of the arising of the intellect, effected by means of the arising and the rest of inquiry in the notions of knowledge with distinctions.
15. The world of the power of the functioning of the intellect.
16. The world of the power of the dissolution of the intellect.
17. The world of the substratum power of the arising of the intellect.
18. The world of the instrument power of the arising of the intellect.
19. The world of the season power of the arising of the intellect.
20. The world of the act power of the arising of the intellect.
21. The world of the aid power of the arising of the intellect.
22. The world of the impelling power of the arising of the intellect.
23. The world of the substratum power of the functioning of the intellect.
24. The world of the instrument power of the functioning of the intellect.
25. The world of the season power of the functioning of the intellect.
26. The world of the act power of the functioning of the intellect.
27. The world of the aid power of the functioning of the intellect.
28. The world of the impelling power of the functioning of the intellect.
29. The world of the substratum power of the dissolution of the intellect.
30. The world of the instrument power of the dissolution of the intellect.
31. The world of the season power of the dissolution of the intellect.
32. The world of the act power of the dissolution of the intellect.
33. The world of the aid power of the dissolution of the intellect.
34. The world of the impelling power of the dissolution of the intellect.
commentary: The intellect (buddhi) is the instrument of knowledge: it inquires and decides. Inquiry is the basis of its worlds; its pervasion reaches as far as the inquiry of purusha, its pervading as far as the vidya tattva.

sections.title: The Tattva Worlds: Cittam

tamil: 10. மூலமாயாந்தர விகற்ப இச்சா ஞானக் கிரியாலேச ஏகதேச காரண காரிய பௌதிகாந்தர இச்சா ஞானக் கிரியா விகற்ப சங்கற்ப மாத்திர சித்த தத்துவ உலகு.
1. பௌதிகாந்தர இச்சா ஞானக் கிரியா விகற்ப சங்கற்ப சிந்தித சமவாயமாத்திர சித்தரூபசத்தி உலகு.
2. பௌதிகாந்தர இச்சா ஞானக் கிரியா விகற்ப சங்கற்ப சிந்தித சமவாய சாத்திய சித்த சொரூபசத்தி உலகு.
3. பௌதிகாந்தர இச்சா ஞானக் கிரியா விகற்ப சங்கற்ப சிந்தித சமவாய கன்ம சாத்தியத்துவ சித்தசுபாவசத்தி உலகு.
6. விகற்ப இச்சா ஞானக் கிரியா சங்கற்ப நியாச விசேட சித்த விசேடசத்தி உலகு.
7. விகற்ப இச்சா ஞானக் கிரியா சங்கற்ப சிந்தித நிபிடத்துவ சித்தகுணசத்தி உலகு.
8. விகற்ப இச்சா ஞானக் கிரியா சங்கற்ப சிந்தித விசித்திரத்துவ சித்தவர்னசத்தி உலகு.
9. விகற்ப இச்சா ஞானக் கிரியா சங்கற்ப சிந்தித சாத்தியத்துவ சித்தபாவ சத்தி உலகு.
10. விகற்ப இச்சா ஞானக் கிரியா சங்கற்ப சிந்தித விசேடத்துவ சித்தபரத்துவசத்தி உலகு.
11. விகற்ப இச்சா ஞானக் கிரியா சங்கற்ப சிந்தித சாமானியத்துவ சித்தஅபரத்துவசத்தி உலகு.
12. விகற்ப இச்சா ஞானக் கிரியா சங்கற்ப சிந்தித அதிட்டானத்துவ சித்தநிமித்தசத்தி உலகு.
13. சிந்தித அதிட்டான விசேடத்துவ சித்தநிமித்த விசேடசத்தி உலகு.
14. விகற்ப இச்சா ஞானக் கிரியா சங்கற்ப சிந்தித உற்பவாதி சாதன சாத்திய சித்தஉற்பவசத்தி உலகு.
translation: 10. The world of the cittam tattva, the distinctions and notions of desire, knowledge and action alone within the physical: the cause and effect of a partial trace of desire, knowledge and action with distinctions within root maya.
1. The world of the form power of cittam, as inherence alone in reflection on the distinctions and notions of desire, knowledge and action within the physical.
2. The world of the own-form power of cittam, effected through inherence in reflection on the distinctions and notions of desire, knowledge and action within the physical.
3. The world of the nature power of cittam, as effected through the act of inherence in reflection on the distinctions and notions of desire, knowledge and action within the physical.
4. The world of the pervasion power of cittam, reaching as far as the purusha tattva.
5. The world of the pervading power of cittam, reaching as far as the vidya tattva.
6. The world of the particular power of cittam, as the particular fixing of the notions of desire, knowledge and action with distinctions.
7. The world of the quality power of cittam, as the density of reflection on the notions of desire, knowledge and action with distinctions.
8. The world of the colour power of cittam, as the manifoldness of reflection on the notions of desire, knowledge and action with distinctions.
9. The world of the being power of cittam, as effected through reflection on the notions of desire, knowledge and action with distinctions.
10. The world of the higher-order power of cittam, as the particularity of reflection on the notions of desire, knowledge and action with distinctions.
11. The world of the lower-order power of cittam, as the generality of reflection on the notions of desire, knowledge and action with distinctions.
12. The world of the instrumental-cause power of cittam, as the ground of reflection on the notions of desire, knowledge and action with distinctions.
13. The world of the particular instrumental-cause power of cittam, as the particularity of the ground of reflection.
14. The world of the power of the arising of cittam, effected by means of the arising and the rest of reflection on the notions of desire, knowledge and action with distinctions.
15. The world of the power of the functioning of cittam.
16. The world of the power of the dissolution of cittam.
17. The world of the substratum power of the arising of cittam.
18. The world of the instrument power of the arising of cittam.
19. The world of the season power of the arising of cittam.
20. The world of the act power of the arising of cittam.
21. The world of the aid power of the arising of cittam.
22. The world of the impelling power of the arising of cittam.
23. The world of the substratum power of the functioning of cittam.
24. The world of the instrument power of the functioning of cittam.
25. The world of the season power of the functioning of cittam.
26. The world of the act power of the functioning of cittam.
27. The world of the aid power of the functioning of cittam.
28. The world of the impelling power of the functioning of cittam.
29. The world of the substratum power of the dissolution of cittam.
30. The world of the instrument power of the dissolution of cittam.
31. The world of the season power of the dissolution of cittam.
32. The world of the act power of the dissolution of cittam.
33. The world of the aid power of the dissolution of cittam.
34. The world of the impelling power of the dissolution of cittam.
commentary: Cittam, the reflecting mind, holds desire, knowledge and action together and reflects on them. With mind, intellect and the sense of "I" it completes the inner instrument.

sections.title: The Tattva Worlds: Root Maya

tamil: 11. மோகினிமாயாகாரிய போக்கிய தத்துவ காரண மூலமாயா தத்துவ உலகு.
2. விகற்பாலம்ப அசுத்தபோக்கிய சாத்திய மூலமாயா சொரூப சத்தி உலகு.
3. சவிகற்பாலம்ப சிற்சட விபரீத சாத்தியத்துவ மூலமாயா சுபாவசத்தி உலகு.
7. நானாபேத அசுத்தாணு சமுதாய சாத்திய மூலமாயா விசேட சத்தி உலகு.
8. நானாபேத அசுத்த விசித்திர மூலமாயா வர்னசத்தி உலகு.
9. நானாபேத அசுத்த விசேட மூலமாயா பரத்துவசத்தி உலகு.
10. நானாபேத அசுத்த சாமானிய மூலமாயா அபரத்துவசத்தி உலகு.
11. நானாபேத அசுத்த சாத்திய மூலமாயா பாவசத்தி உலகு.
translation: 11. The world of the root maya tattva, the effect of mohini maya and the cause of the tattvas that are enjoyed.
1. The world of the form power of root maya, as inherence, with what has distinctions as basis.
2. The world of the own-form power of root maya, effected through the impure enjoyed, with distinctions as basis.
3. The world of the nature power of root maya, as effected through the inversion of consciousness and the inert, with what has distinctions as basis.
4. The world of the pervasion power of root maya, reaching as far as the elements.
5. The world of the pervading power of root maya, reaching as far as mohini maya.
6. The world of the quality power of root maya, as the impure enjoyed.
7. The world of the particular power of root maya, effected through the collection of impure atoms of many kinds.
8. The world of the colour power of root maya, impure and manifold, of many kinds.
9. The world of the higher-order power of root maya, impure and particular, of many kinds.
10. The world of the lower-order power of root maya, impure and general, of many kinds.
11. The world of the being power of root maya, impure and effected, of many kinds.
12. The world of the instrumental-cause power of root maya, as the impure ground.
13. The world of the particular instrumental-cause power of root maya, as the particular impure ground.
14. The world of the power of the arising of root maya.
15. The world of the power of the functioning of root maya.
16. The world of the power of the dissolution of root maya.
17. The world of the substratum power of the arising of root maya.
18. The world of the instrument power of the arising of root maya.
19. The world of the season power of the arising of root maya.
20. The world of the act power of the arising of root maya.
21. The world of the aid power of the arising of root maya.
22. The world of the impelling power of the arising of root maya.
23. The world of the substratum power of the functioning of root maya.
24. The world of the instrument power of the functioning of root maya.
25. The world of the season power of the functioning of root maya.
26. The world of the act power of the functioning of root maya.
27. The world of the aid power of the functioning of root maya.
28. The world of the impelling power of the functioning of root maya.
29. The world of the substratum power of the dissolution of root maya.
30. The world of the instrument power of the dissolution of root maya.
31. The world of the season power of the dissolution of root maya.
32. The world of the act power of the dissolution of root maya.
33. The world of the aid power of the dissolution of root maya.
34. The world of the impelling power of the dissolution of root maya.
commentary: Root maya (mūlamāyā) is the material source of the tattvas the soul enjoys: the effect of mohini, the deluding maya, and the cause of all that is impure and enjoyed. Its nature, item 3 says, is the inversion of consciousness and the inert: taking the one for the other. Even this is counted among the worlds that Ulagelam holds.

sections.title: The Tattva Worlds: The Gunas

tamil: 12. மூலமாயா வாகியாந்தர ஏகதேச காரிய பௌதிகாந்தர கரண விகற்ப விசித்திர சங்கற்ப வியத்தி காரண குண தத்துவ உலகு.
translation: In the same way:

12. The world of the tattva of the gunas, the cause of the manifestation of the manifold notions and distinctions of the instruments within the physical: a partial effect of root maya, outer and inner.
1. The world of the form power of the gunas.
2. The world of the own-form power of the gunas.
3. The world of the nature power of the gunas.
4. The world of the pervasion power of the gunas.
5. The world of the pervading power of the gunas.
6. The world of the particular power of the gunas.
7. The world of the quality power of the gunas.
8. The world of the colour power of the gunas.
9. The world of the being power of the gunas.
10. The world of the higher-order power of the gunas.
11. The world of the lower-order power of the gunas.
12. The world of the instrumental-cause power of the gunas.
13. The world of the particular instrumental-cause power of the gunas.
14. The world of the power of the arising of the gunas.
15. The world of the power of the functioning of the gunas.
16. The world of the power of the dissolution of the gunas.
17. The world of the substratum power of the arising of the gunas.
18. The world of the instrument power of the arising of the gunas.
19. The world of the season power of the arising of the gunas.
20. The world of the act power of the arising of the gunas.
21. The world of the aid power of the arising of the gunas.
22. The world of the impelling power of the arising of the gunas.
23. The world of the substratum power of the functioning of the gunas.
24. The world of the instrument power of the functioning of the gunas.
25. The world of the season power of the functioning of the gunas.
26. The world of the act power of the functioning of the gunas.
27. The world of the aid power of the functioning of the gunas.
28. The world of the impelling power of the functioning of the gunas.
29. The world of the substratum power of the dissolution of the gunas.
30. The world of the instrument power of the dissolution of the gunas.
31. The world of the season power of the dissolution of the gunas.
32. The world of the act power of the dissolution of the gunas.
33. The world of the aid power of the dissolution of the gunas.
34. The world of the impelling power of the dissolution of the gunas.
commentary: The gunas are the three qualities of prakriti (sattva, rajas and tamas). The head makes them the cause through which the manifold notions of the instruments become manifest. Their thirty-four worlds are listed bare, with no qualifiers.

sections.title: The Tattva Worlds: The Outer Instruments

tamil: 13. பூதகாரிய பௌதிகாதார பிரதி பந்தக நாடி தத்துவ உலகு.
14. தனு கரண சையோக சம்பந்த வியாபார காரண வாயு விகற்ப காரிய பிராணாதி தத்துவ உலகு.
15. தனு கரண பாகியாந்தர சௌபாதிகப் பிரதிபந்தக லிங்கமாத்திர கோச தத்துவ உலகு.
16. மூலமாயா பாகிய விகற்பக் கிரியாலேச ஏகதேச காரிய வியத்திமாத்திர வசனாதி தத்துவ உலகு.
5. வசனாதி வியாபகசத்தி உலகு முதலியவும் ஆகிய புறக்கருவி உலகுங் கொள்க.
translation: 13. The world of the tattva of the nadis, the effect of the elements, the support and restraint of the physical.
1. The world of the form power of the nadis.
2. The world of the own-form power of the nadis.
3. The world of the nature power of the nadis.
4. The world of the pervasion power of the nadis.
5. The world of the pervading power of the nadis.
6. The world of the particular power of the nadis, and the like,
14. The world of the tattva of prana and the other vital airs, the effect of the distinctions of air, the cause of the activity in relation to the conjunction of body and instruments.
1. The world of the form power of prana and the other vital airs.
2. The world of the own-form power of prana and the other vital airs.
3. The world of the nature power of prana and the other vital airs.
4. The world of the pervasion power of prana and the other vital airs.
5. The world of the pervading power of prana and the other vital airs.
6. The world of the particular power of prana and the other vital airs, and the like,
15. The world of the tattva of the sheaths, the mark alone, the restraint with adjuncts, outer and inner, of body and instruments.
1. The world of the form power of the sheaths.
2. The world of the own-form power of the sheaths.
3. The world of the nature power of the sheaths.
4. The world of the pervasion power of the sheaths.
5. The world of the pervading power of the sheaths.
6. The world of the particular power of the sheaths, and the like,
16. The world of the tattva of speech and the other actions, manifestation alone: a partial effect of a trace of outer action, with distinctions, of root maya.
1. The world of the form power of speech and the other actions.
2. The world of the own-form power of speech and the other actions.
3. The world of the nature power of speech and the other actions.
4. The world of the pervasion power of speech and the other actions.
5. The world of the pervading power of speech and the other actions, and the like: these, the worlds of the outer instruments, are also to be counted.
commentary: Four smaller tattva worlds: the nadis (the channels of the vital breath), prana and the other vital airs, the sheaths (kosas, the coverings of the soul's body), and speech and the other actions. Each is given its first six or five aspects; "and the like" leaves the rest of each run to be supplied. The closing line names all four together: the worlds of the outer instruments.

sections.title: The Tattva Worlds: Time

tamil: 17. பூத பௌதிக இந்திரிய கரண குண புவன போகாதிஸ்தூல சூக்கும சாதாரண அசாதாரண கிரியா விகற்ப வியாபாரவிசித்திரபாகியாந்தர உபயகன்ம போக்கியாபோக்கிய உபகார பக்குவ சம்பந்தாதிகார கரண சுத்தாசுத்த பரமாணுக்காரிய காலதத்துவ உலகு.
1. சுத்தாசுத்த விகற்பத்திரயப் பிரத்தியாங்க ஜீவ சாமீப்பிய காலரூபசத்தி உலகு.
2. சுத்தாசுத்த விகற்பத்திரயப் பிரத்தியாங்க பக்குவ சாத்திய காலசொரூபசத்தி உலகு.
translation: 17. The world of the time tattva, the effect of the pure-impure ultimate atom: the instrument governing the relation of the aid and ripening of the twofold karma, enjoyed and not enjoyed, in the manifold activity, outer and inner, of action with distinctions, gross and subtle, common and uncommon, in the elements, the physical, the senses, the instruments, the gunas, the bhuvanas, the enjoyments and the rest.
1. The world of the form power of time, near the soul, as a minor limb of the threefold pure-impure distinction.
2. The world of the own-form power of time, effected through ripening, as a minor limb of the threefold pure-impure distinction.
3. The world of the nature power of time, as pure-impure effect.
4. The world of the quality power of time, as enjoyment of many distinctions.
5. The world of the pervasion power of time, reaching as far as maya.
6. The world of the pervading power of time, reaching as far as anava.
7. The world of the particular power of time, effected with distinctions.
In the same way:
8. The world of the colour power of time.
9. The world of the being power of time.
10. The world of the higher-order power of time.
11. The world of the lower-order power of time.
12. The world of the instrumental-cause power of time.
13. The world of the particular instrumental-cause power of time.
14. The world of the power of the arising of time.
15. The world of the power of the functioning of time.
16. The world of the power of the dissolution of time.
17. The world of the substratum power of the arising of time.
18. The world of the instrument power of the arising of time.
19. The world of the season power of the arising of time.
20. The world of the act power of the arising of time.
21. The world of the aid power of the arising of time.
22. The world of the impelling power of the arising of time.
23. The world of the substratum power of the functioning of time.
24. The world of the instrument power of the functioning of time.
25. The world of the season power of the functioning of time.
26. The world of the act power of the functioning of time.
27. The world of the aid power of the functioning of time.
28. The world of the impelling power of the functioning of time.
29. The world of the substratum power of the dissolution of time.
30. The world of the instrument power of the dissolution of time.
31. The world of the season power of the dissolution of time.
32. The world of the act power of the dissolution of time.
33. The world of the aid power of the dissolution of time.
34. The world of the impelling power of the dissolution of time.
commentary: Now the tattvas that bind the soul to experience. Time arises from the pure-impure ultimate atom of maya and governs the ripening of the soul's twofold karma, good and bad, enjoyed and not yet enjoyed. Its threefold distinction is past, present and future. It stands near the soul, and its pervading reaches as far as anava, the soul's innate darkness.

sections.title: The Tattva Worlds: Niyati

tamil: 18. தூல சூக்கும சாதாரண அசாதாரண தனு கரண புவன போகாதி கிரியா விகற்ப விசித்திர கன்ம வியாபார பரிமாண கரண சுத்தாசுத்த பரமாணுக்காரிய நியதி தத்துவ உலகு.
1. விசித்திர கன்ம வியாபார பரிமாண கரணத்துவப் பிரத்தியாங்க ஜீவ சாமீப்பிய நியதிரூபசத்தி உலகு.
2. விசித்திர கன்ம வியாபார பரிமாண கரண சாத்திய நியதி சொரூபசத்தி உலகு.
3. சுத்தாசுத்த கன்ம பரிமாண பரமாணுத்துவ நியதி சுபாவசத்தி உலகு.
translation: 18. The world of the niyati tattva, the effect of the pure-impure ultimate atom: the instrument that measures the activity of the manifold karma of action with distinctions, in bodies, instruments, bhuvanas, enjoyments and the rest, gross and subtle, common and uncommon.
1. The world of the form power of niyati, a minor limb near the soul, as the instrument that measures the activity of manifold karma.
2. The world of the own-form power of niyati, effected through the instrument that measures the activity of manifold karma.
3. The world of the nature power of niyati, as the ultimate atomicity that measures pure-impure karma.
4. The world of the quality power of niyati, as the enjoyment of pure-impure distinctions.
5. The world of the pervasion power of niyati, reaching as far as maya.
6. The world of the pervading power of niyati, reaching as far as anava.
7. The world of the particular power of niyati, as many distinctions.
In the same way:
8. The world of the colour power of niyati.
9. The world of the being power of niyati.
10. The world of the higher-order power of niyati.
11. The world of the lower-order power of niyati.
12. The world of the instrumental-cause power of niyati.
13. The world of the particular instrumental-cause power of niyati.
14. The world of the power of the arising of niyati.
15. The world of the power of the functioning of niyati.
16. The world of the power of the dissolution of niyati.
17. The world of the substratum power of the arising of niyati.
18. The world of the instrument power of the arising of niyati.
19. The world of the season power of the arising of niyati.
20. The world of the act power of the arising of niyati.
21. The world of the aid power of the arising of niyati.
22. The world of the impelling power of the arising of niyati.
23. The world of the substratum power of the functioning of niyati.
24. The world of the instrument power of the functioning of niyati.
25. The world of the season power of the functioning of niyati.
26. The world of the act power of the functioning of niyati.
27. The world of the aid power of the functioning of niyati.
28. The world of the impelling power of the functioning of niyati.
29. The world of the substratum power of the dissolution of niyati.
30. The world of the instrument power of the dissolution of niyati.
31. The world of the season power of the dissolution of niyati.
32. The world of the act power of the dissolution of niyati.
33. The world of the aid power of the dissolution of niyati.
34. The world of the impelling power of the dissolution of niyati.
commentary: Niyati, order, is the instrument that measures out karma, so that each soul meets the fruit of its own deeds and no other. Like time it stands near the soul and reaches as far as maya and anava.

sections.title: The Tattva Worlds: Kalā

tamil: 19. மூலமாயாகாரண சுத்தாசுத்த மோகினிமாயா பரமாணுக்காரிய சௌபாதிகாரம்ப ஆன்மோபர கிரியாலேச ஏகதேச பாசலேச அநாவாரகரண கலா தத்துவ உலகு.
1. ஜீவசாமீப்பியப் பிரத்தியாங்க பாசலேச அநாவார கரணத்துவ கலாரூபசத்தி உலகு.
2. சவிகற்ப இச்சா ஞானக் கிரியாலேச வியத்தி உபகார சாத்திய கலா சொரூபசத்தி உலகு.
translation: 19. The world of the kalā tattva, the instrument that unveils a trace of bondage: a partial trace of action bearing upon the soul, beginning with adjuncts, the effect of the ultimate atom of pure-impure mohini maya, the cause of root maya.
1. The world of the form power of kalā, a minor limb near the soul, as the instrument that unveils a trace of bondage.
2. The world of the own-form power of kalā, effected through aid to the manifestation of a trace of desire, knowledge and action with distinctions.
3. The world of the nature power of kalā, effected as pure-impure.
4. The world of the quality power of kalā, as the enjoyment of mohini maya.
5. The world of the pervasion power of kalā, reaching as far as mohini maya.
6. The world of the pervading power of kalā, reaching as far as a trace of anava.
7. The world of the particular power of kalā, effected through many distinctions.
In the same way:
8. The world of the colour power of kalā.
9. The world of the being power of kalā.
10. The world of the higher-order power of kalā.
11. The world of the lower-order power of kalā.
12. The world of the instrumental-cause power of kalā.
13. The world of the particular instrumental-cause power of kalā.
14. The world of the power of the arising of kalā.
15. The world of the power of the functioning of kalā.
16. The world of the power of the dissolution of kalā.
17. The world of the substratum power of the arising of kalā.
18. The world of the instrument power of the arising of kalā.
19. The world of the season power of the arising of kalā.
20. The world of the act power of the arising of kalā.
21. The world of the aid power of the arising of kalā.
22. The world of the impelling power of the arising of kalā.
23. The world of the substratum power of the functioning of kalā.
24. The world of the instrument power of the functioning of kalā.
25. The world of the season power of the functioning of kalā.
26. The world of the act power of the functioning of kalā.
27. The world of the aid power of the functioning of kalā.
28. The world of the impelling power of the functioning of kalā.
29. The world of the substratum power of the dissolution of kalā.
30. The world of the instrument power of the dissolution of kalā.
31. The world of the season power of the dissolution of kalā.
32. The world of the act power of the dissolution of kalā.
33. The world of the aid power of the dissolution of kalā.
34. The world of the impelling power of the dissolution of kalā.
commentary: Kalā arises from mohini maya and lifts a trace of the soul's bondage, so that a trace of its desire, knowledge and action can shine out. That small unveiling is the soul's first step out of darkness; the full lifting of the veil is the work of Grace. After the aspects come the three phases of every tattva, arising, functioning and dissolution, each taken through six sub-aspects: substratum, instrument, season, act, aid and impelling. So kalā, like each tattva, holds thirty-four worlds.

sections.title: The Tattva Worlds: Vidya

tamil: 20. கலாதத்துவ காரிய சௌபாதிகான்மோபர மாயா ஞானலேச ஏகதேச வியத்தி கரண வித்யா தத்துவ உலகு.
1. மாயா ஞானலேச ஏகதேச வியத்தி ஜீவ சாமீப்பியப் பிரத்தியாங்க கரணத்துவ வித்தியாரூபசத்தி உலகு.
2. மாயா ஞானலேச ஏகதேச வியத்திகரணத்துவ சாத்திய வித்தியாசொரூபசத்தி உலகு.
translation: 20. The world of the vidya tattva, produced from the kalā tattva, bearing upon the soul with adjuncts, the instrument of the partial manifestation of a trace of knowledge from maya.
1. The world of the form power of vidya, as the instrument, a minor limb near the soul, of the partial manifestation of a trace of knowledge from maya.
2. The world of the own-form power of vidya, effected as the instrument of the partial manifestation of a trace of knowledge from maya.
3. The world of the nature power of vidya, as a pure-impure effect.
4. The world of the quality power of vidya, as pure-impure enjoyment.
5. The world of the pervasion power of vidya, reaching as far as maya.
6. The world of the pervading power of vidya, reaching as far as anava.
7. The world of the particular power of vidya, effected through many distinctions.
In the same way:
8. The world of the colour power of vidya.
9. The world of the being power of vidya.
10. The world of the higher-order power of vidya.
11. The world of the lower-order power of vidya.
12. The world of the instrumental-cause power of vidya.
13. The world of the particular instrumental-cause power of vidya.
14. The world of the power of the arising of vidya.
15. The world of the power of the functioning of vidya.
16. The world of the power of the dissolution of vidya.
17. The world of the substratum power of the arising of vidya.
18. The world of the instrument power of the arising of vidya.
19. The world of the season power of the arising of vidya.
20. The world of the act power of the arising of vidya.
21. The world of the aid power of the arising of vidya.
22. The world of the impelling power of the arising of vidya.
23. The world of the substratum power of the functioning of vidya.
24. The world of the instrument power of the functioning of vidya.
25. The world of the season power of the functioning of vidya.
26. The world of the act power of the functioning of vidya.
27. The world of the aid power of the functioning of vidya.
28. The world of the impelling power of the functioning of vidya.
29. The world of the substratum power of the dissolution of vidya.
30. The world of the instrument power of the dissolution of vidya.
31. The world of the season power of the dissolution of vidya.
32. The world of the act power of the dissolution of vidya.
33. The world of the aid power of the dissolution of vidya.
34. The world of the impelling power of the dissolution of vidya.
commentary: Vidya is produced from kalā. It is the instrument by which the soul knows a little: a trace of knowledge, shown in part. Like kalā, it acts on the soul with adjuncts and stays close to it as a minor limb. Its pervasion reaches as far as maya, and its pervading reaches as far as anava, the soul's innate darkness.

sections.title: The Tattva Worlds: Raga

tamil: 21. வித்தியாதத்துவ காரிய சௌபாதிகாரம்பான்மோபர விகற்ப இச்சாலேச ஏகதேச வியத்தி கரண அராக தத்துவ உலகு.
1. விகற்ப இச்சாலேச ஏகதேச வியத்தி கரணத்துவ ஜீவசாமீப்பியப் பிரத்தியாங்க அராக ரூபசத்தி உலகு.
2. மாயா இச்சாலேச வியத்தி சாத்திய அராகசொரூபசத்தி உலகு.
translation: 21. The world of the raga tattva, produced from the vidya tattva, beginning with adjuncts and bearing upon the soul, the instrument of the partial manifestation of a trace of desire with distinctions.
1. The world of the form power of raga, as the instrument of the partial manifestation of a trace of desire with distinctions, a minor limb near the soul.
2. The world of the own-form power of raga, effected through the manifestation of a trace of desire from maya.
3. The world of the nature power of raga, as pure-impure.
4. The world of the quality power of raga, as pure-impure enjoyment.
5. The world of the pervasion power of raga, reaching as far as maya.
6. The world of the pervading power of raga, reaching as far as anava.
7. The world of the particular power of raga, as many distinctions.
In the same way:
8. The world of the colour power of raga.
9. The world of the being power of raga.

11. The world of the lower-order power of raga.

34. The world of the impelling power of the dissolution of raga.
commentary: Raga, attachment, is produced from vidya. It brings out a trace of desire, just as vidya brings out a trace of knowledge. The Tamil names it arākam in items 1-7 and rākam from item 8; both are the same tattva.

sections.title: The Tattva Worlds: Purusha

tamil: 22. கலாதிதத்துவ சையோக ஆந்தரவாகிய மாயாபோக்கிய அதிகரணத்துவ புருட தத்துவ உலகு.
2. விகற்ப விஷயானுபவ சாத்திய புருட சொரூபசத்தி உலகு.
translation: 22. The world of the purusha tattva, in conjunction with kalā and the other tattvas, as the substratum of what is enjoyed of maya, inner and outer.
1. The world of the form power of purusha, a minor limb near the soul.
2. The world of the own-form power of purusha, effected through the experience of objects with distinctions.
3. The world of the nature power of purusha, as pure-impure.
4. The world of the quality power of purusha, as enjoyment with distinctions.
5. The world of the pervasion power of purusha, reaching as far as maya.
6. The world of the pervading power of purusha, reaching as far as anava.
7. The world of the particular power of purusha, as many distinctions.
In the same way:

11. The world of the lower-order power of purusha.

32. The world of the act power of the dissolution of purusha.
33. The world of the aid power of the dissolution of purusha.
34. The world of the impelling power of the dissolution of purusha.
commentary: Purusha is the soul as enjoyer. It is the soul joined with kalā and the other limiting tattvas, and through them it experiences objects inner and outer. The tattva is the substratum of all that maya offers to be enjoyed. Each of its distinctions is a world of its own.

sections.title: The Tattva Worlds: Pure-impure Maya

tamil: 23. சுத்தமாயாகாரிய தூலசூக்குமப் பிரபஞ்ச காரண சுத்தாசுத்தமாயா தத்துவ உலகு.
2. துவிமுக வியக்தி சாத்திய சுத்தாசுத்தமாயா சொரூபசத்தி உலகு.
3. ஆரோப அதிட்டான விகற்பத்துவ சுத்தாசுத்தமாயா சுபாவசத்தி உலகு.
7. தூல சூக்கும சரீரத்துவ சுத்தாசுத்தமாயா விசேடசத்தி உலகு.
23. சுத்தாசுத்த மாயா அதிகார அதிகரண சத்தி உலகு.
translation: 23. The world of the pure-impure maya tattva, produced from pure maya, the cause of the gross and subtle universe.
1. The world of the form power of pure-impure maya, as an instrument with the prakriti tattva as basis.
2. The world of the own-form power of pure-impure maya, effected through twofold manifestation.
3. The world of the nature power of pure-impure maya, as the distinction of superimposition and ground.
4. The world of the pervasion power of pure-impure maya, reaching as far as the karma-atom.
5. The world of the pervading power of pure-impure maya, as governing many manifold imaginings.
6. The world of the quality power of pure-impure maya, as the difference in the experience of karma.
7. The world of the particular power of pure-impure maya, as the gross and subtle body.
In the same way:
8. The world of the colour power of pure-impure maya.
9. The world of the being power of pure-impure maya.
10. The world of the higher-order power of pure-impure maya.
11. The world of the lower-order power of pure-impure maya.

14. The world of the power of the arising of pure-impure maya.
15. The world of the power of the functioning of pure-impure maya.

18. The world of the instrument power of the arising of pure-impure maya.

20. The world of the act power of the arising of pure-impure maya.

26. The world of the act power of the functioning of pure-impure maya.
27. The world of the aid power of the functioning of pure-impure maya.
28. The world of the impelling power of the functioning of pure-impure maya.
29. The world of the substratum power of the dissolution of pure-impure maya.
30. The world of the instrument power of the dissolution of pure-impure maya.
31. The world of the season power of the dissolution of pure-impure maya.

commentary: Pure-impure maya is produced from pure maya and is the cause of the gross and subtle universe; prakriti rests on it. Its nature is described as "superimposition and ground": the many forms appear on a ground that lies beneath them. Its quality is the difference in the experience of karma, and its particular power is the gross and subtle body.

sections.title: The Tattva Worlds: Karma

tamil: 24. தூல சூக்குமப் பிரபஞ்ச உபகாரண துவிமுக விவிதபேதத் திரய கரணாலம்பித கரண சாத்திய கன்ம தத்துவ உலகு.
1. அசேதன சேதனாலம்பித விகற்ப தன்மாதன்ம காரணத்துவ கன்மரூபசத்தி உலகு.
2. அசேதன சேதன துவிமுக விவித பேதாலம்பன ஆகார ஆயுசாதி சாத்திய கன்மசொரூபசத்தி உலகு.
translation: 24. The world of the karma tattva, the auxiliary cause of the gross and subtle universe, twofold, of various kinds, effected through the instruments, resting on the three instruments.
1. The world of the form power of karma, as the cause of righteousness and unrighteousness with distinctions, resting on the insentient and the sentient.
2. The world of the own-form power of karma, effected through form, lifespan and the rest, with the twofold, various kinds of the insentient and the sentient as basis.
3. The world of the nature power of karma, as conjunction with twofold kinds as basis.
4. The world of the pervasion power of karma, reaching as far as impure maya.
5. The world of the pervading power of karma, reaching as far as the gross and the subtle.
6. The world of the quality power of karma, as the cause of the distinctions of joy and suffering.
7. The world of the particular power of karma, effected through the kinds of various, manifold experience.
In the same way:
8. The world of the colour power of karma.
9. The world of the being power of karma.
10. The world of the higher-order power of karma.
11. The world of the lower-order power of karma.
12. The world of the instrumental-cause power of karma.
13. The world of the particular instrumental-cause power of karma.
14. The world of the power of the arising of karma.
15. The world of the power of the functioning of karma.
16. The world of the power of the dissolution of karma.
17. The world of the substratum power of the arising of karma.
18. The world of the instrument power of the arising of karma.
19. The world of the season power of the arising of karma.
20. The world of the act power of the arising of karma.
21. The world of the aid power of the arising of karma.
22. The world of the impelling power of the arising of karma.
23. The world of the substratum power of the functioning of karma.
24. The world of the instrument power of the functioning of karma.
25. The world of the season power of the functioning of karma.
26. The world of the act power of the functioning of karma.
27. The world of the aid power of the functioning of karma.
28. The world of the impelling power of the functioning of karma.
29. The world of the substratum power of the dissolution of karma.
30. The world of the instrument power of the dissolution of karma.
31. The world of the season power of the dissolution of karma.
32. The world of the act power of the dissolution of karma.
33. The world of the aid power of the dissolution of karma.
34. The world of the impelling power of the dissolution of karma.
commentary: Karma, the deeds that bind, is "twofold": right and wrong, the cause of joy and suffering. It rests on the three instruments, read here as thought, word and deed, and it shapes each body's form and lifespan. Its pervasion reaches as far as impure maya. In the run, karma is the subject, and the same Tamil word in the sub-aspect slot is rendered "act".

sections.title: The Tattva Worlds: Pure Vidya

2. The world of the own-form power of pure vidya, effected through stainless form.
3. The world of the nature power of pure vidya, as primal and eternal.
4. The world of the quality power of pure vidya, establishing pure maya.
5. The world of the particular power of pure vidya, establishing supremacy.
In the same way:
6. The world of the colour power of pure vidya.
7. The world of the being power of pure vidya.
8. The world of the higher-order power of pure vidya.
9. The world of the lower-order power of pure vidya.

commentary: The five pure tattvas begin here: pure vidya, Isvara, Sadakhya, Bindu and Nada. They are free of impurity, so their form is a "stainless instrument" and their nature is "primal and eternal". Each sets a lower tattva to work. Pure vidya impels pure-impure vidya. Their runs have five qualified aspects, so they end at thirty-two.

43. The world of Pratishtha.
44. The world of Vidya.
45. The world of Santi.
46. The world of Santyatita.
47. The world of Dipika.
48. The world of Rochika.
49. The world of Mochika.
50. The world of Vyomarupa.
51. The world of Ananta.
52. The world of Anatha.
53. The world of Anasrita.
54. The world of Sukshma.
55. The world of Pasyanti.
56. The world of Madhyama.
57. The world of Vaikhari.
In the same way, of each of these:
1. The world of the form power.
2. The world of the own-form power.
3. The world of the nature power.
4. The world of the pervasion power.
5. The world of the pervading power.
6. The world of the quality power, and the like are also to be counted.
commentary: Now come one-line worlds. They are pure maya, the cause of the universe of word and meaning; yoga maya; Nada, named again in this new setting; and the lower Bindu. Then come named powers, the five kalās (Nivritti to Santyatita) and the four levels of speech, from the subtlest sound (Sukshma) to spoken words (Vaikhari). The closing lines add that each of these worlds also has its form, own form, nature, pervasion, pervading and quality.

sections.title: The Tattva Worlds: The Letters, Words, Mantras and Bhuvanas

tamil: பிரதிட்டை உலகு முதலிய கலை உலகு முதலிய அத்துவா உலகனைத்துங் கொள்க.

Count also all the worlds of the paths (adhvas): the worlds of the kalās, beginning with the world of Pratishtha, and the rest.
commentary: Saiva teaching orders all the worlds by six paths (adhvas): letter, word, mantra, bhuvana, tattva and kalā. Here the letters, from A; the words, from Om; the mantras, from Sadyojata; and the bhuvanas, from Aja up to the world of Sadasiva, are each counted as worlds. The last line adds the kalās and all the worlds of the paths, so all six fall within Ulagelam. After Kapali the print adds "(first)".

sections.title: The Tattva Worlds: Kudilai

tamil: 93. சர்வ சத்தார்த்தப் பிரபஞ்ச சாதாரண சமவாய அதிகாரத்துவ குடிலை தத்துவ உலகு.
translation: 93. The world of the Kudilai tattva, governing by inherence, common to the whole universe of word and meaning.
1. The world of the form power of Kudilai, as the letter of Omkara.
2. The world of the own-form power of Kudilai, in the form of many hoods.
3. The world of the nature power of Kudilai, as constant manifestation alone.
4. The world of the pervasion power of Kudilai, as action alone.
5. The world of the pervading power of Kudilai, effected through dense knowledge.
6. The world of the quality power of Kudilai, as the distinction of the soul's knowledge.
7. The world of the particular power of Kudilai, as the support of what inheres.
8. The world of the colour power of Kudilai.
9. The world of the being power of Kudilai.
10. The world of the higher-order power of Kudilai.
11. The world of the lower-order power of Kudilai.
12. The world of the instrumental-cause power of Kudilai.
13. The world of the particular instrumental-cause power of Kudilai.
14. The world of the power of the arising of Kudilai.
15. The world of the power of the functioning of Kudilai.
16. The world of the power of the dissolution of Kudilai.
17. The world of the substratum power of the arising of Kudilai.
18. The world of the instrument power of the arising of Kudilai.
19. The world of the season power of the arising of Kudilai.

24. The world of the instrument power of the functioning of Kudilai.
